title: Enrichment
for: contact and company data: enriching target accounts and people in data/accounts

manual.export: export the enriched list from the tool as CSV (one row per person or account, with the company domain and the fields you asked for)

vendors.name: Apollo.io
caveats: the survey confirmed read tools only; sequence write tools are not verified, and if the tool list shows any create, add or send tool, deny the whole server (`mcp__apollo`) until reviewed
the same `apollo` server appears in outbound.json for sequences
in the Claude connectors directory for Claude, not for Claude Code
the plugin repo is on the vendor's GitHub; the endpoint is from a secondary listing, confirm before wiring

vendors.name: Clay
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__clay`) until checked
writes drive Clay tables, which spend credits; humans decide before a bulk run
in the Claude connectors directory; endpoint seen in a secondary listing, confirm on the developer page before wiring

vendors.name: ZoomInfo
caveats: needs a ZoomInfo licence for the signing-in user
in the Claude connectors directory; endpoint seen in a secondary listing, confirm on the docs page before wiring
Chorus (call intelligence) has no separate server

vendors.name: Lusha
caveats: 17 read tools; no write tools documented
the API key header is `x-api-key`, lowercase; OAuth exists only through the official connectors in Claude, ChatGPT and Codex
repo `lusha-oss/lusha-public-api-mcp` is on the vendor's GitHub; the endpoint was read on the vendor docs page today

vendors.name: Hunter.io
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__hunter`) until checked (the vendor page names leads create and update and list organisation)
available on all plans; verifications and searches spend credits
endpoint read on the vendor page today; the survey marks it as a secondary listing

auth.where: browser grant on first use, where the client supports it

vendors.name: FullEnrich
caveats: every enrichment spends credits; humans decide before a bulk run
auth is a browser sign-in with the FullEnrich account; no API key header is documented for the MCP
endpoint read on the vendor help page today; the survey marks it as a secondary listing

auth.where: browser sign-in with the FullEnrich account on first use

vendors.name: Dropcontact
caveats: an official server is announced on the vendor page with API-key auth, but the endpoint was not on the page fetched; wire it only after reading the setup instructions there

vendors.name: People Data Labs
caveats: no official server
community server maintained by phxdev1 (`phxdev1/peopledatalabs-mcp`, 2 stars, stale); judge as a script, not a vendor tool
a stdlib script against the REST API is the sensible route

vendors.name: Clearbit (HubSpot Breeze Intelligence)
caveats: no official server; Breeze Intelligence is HubSpot-locked, so reach the enriched properties through the HubSpot MCP (crm.json) instead
Pipedream and Composio expose a Clearbit action; those are generic connectors, not a vendor server

vendors.name: Cognism
caveats: conflicting reports of an MCP server; nothing verified on the vendor site
use the manual route: export the list as CSV
